items.key: Counts show assessment assignments and responses. A participant may appear in several assessments. Missing numerical answers remain unknown. Awaiting review means closed but not shared; it is not a separate recorded approval status.
items.draft: Amanani abonisa ukwabelwa kovavanyo neempendulo. Umthathi-nxaxheba usenokubonakala kuvavanyo oluliqela. Iimpendulo zamanani ezingekhoyo zihlala zingaziwa. Ilindele uphononongo ithetha ivaliwe kodwa ayabelwananga; asiso simo sohlukileyo semvume esirekhodiweyo.
items.backtranslation: The numbers show assignment of assessment and responses. A participant may appear in several assessments. Missing numeric responses remain unknown. Awaiting review means closed but not shared; it is not a separate recorded consent status.
items.problem: "approval status" rendered as "isimo semvume" (consent status): consent meaning added
